title: Beatrix and the Witness
author: E. M. Sandoval
blurb: Oscar Coldharbour, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
